root.label: Threads, jthread & locks
root.note: RAII thread lifetimes, cooperative stop tokens, and structured synchronization prevent leaks and races.

children.label: Thread ownership (thread vs jthread)
children.note: Raw std::thread aborts if unjoined; std::jthread stops and joins automatically.

children.label: ~thread() calls std::terminate()
children.note: Destroying a joinable std::thread aborts rather than silently detaching or deadlocking.

children.label: ~jthread() stops then joins
children.note: Requests stop on its internal stop_source and joins before leaving scope.

children.label: Declare jthread member last
children.note: Reverse member destruction joins the worker before mutexes or state are destroyed.

children.label: Cooperative cancellation
children.note: stop_source and stop_token coordinate clean shutdown without async kills.

children.label: stop_source & stop_token
children.note: Reference-counted atomic stop state injected automatically into jthread callables.

children.label: Synchronous stop_callback
children.note: Runs immediately in its constructor if stop was already requested, preventing missed signals.

children.label: condition_variable_any stop wait
children.note: wait(lk, st, pred) registers a stop_callback internally to wake sleeping waiters.

children.label: Mutexes & RAII locks
children.note: Scope-bound lock wrappers match single, multi-mutex, and reader-writer patterns.

children.label: scoped_lock avoids deadlocks
children.note: Locks multiple mutexes via std::lock without ordering deadlocks.

children.label: unique_lock for deferral & CVs
children.note: Movable wrapper supporting defer_lock, early unlock(), and condition variables.

children.label: shared_mutex & shared_lock
children.note: Allows concurrent readers under shared_lock and exclusive writers under unique_lock.

children.label: Unnamed lock temporary trap
children.note: Omitting a variable name unlocks immediately at the semicolon before the guarded block.

children.label: Condition variables
children.note: Predicate waits guard against spurious wakeups and lost notifications.

children.label: Always pass a predicate
children.note: cv.wait(lk, pred) loops under the lock so spurious wakeups cannot break invariants.

children.label: Unlock before notify
children.note: Releasing the mutex prior to notify prevents woken threads from immediately stalling.

children.label: C++20 coordination & call_once
children.note: Latches, barriers, semaphores, and once_flag cover phased and cross-thread signaling.

children.label: Single-use std::latch
children.note: Downward counter where threads wait until arrivals reduce the count to zero.

children.label: Reusable noexcept std::barrier
children.note: Phased rendezvous mandating a nothrow-invocable completion callable.

children.label: Unowned counting_semaphore
children.note: Permits one thread to release() a token acquired by another thread.

children.label: Exception-retrying call_once
children.note: If the first callable throws, another waiting thread retries initialization.
